answer: Resist sybils by staking scarce, slow-to-forge reputation bonded to a unique work trail. New identities start with zero weight until peers attest their outputs across epochs; cloned accounts cannot borrow that trail. Think of saffron threads priced by rarity, nectar that only real foragers distill, and timber rings that record years of growth—cheap copies lack rings, nectar, and the saffron cost of earning each attestation.
